messages:
Ravi: Heads up everyone 10am check: found an unlabelled jar of something sticky (brownish) behind the hummus. Smells like tamarind? anyone claim it? :thinking_face:
Nina: Not mine. If it's tamarind that's from the potluck last week. Can we toss unlabeled stuff older than 3 days?
Theo: I vote toss. Also, FYI coffee stash is low 1 bag left (dark roast). Refill poll: should I pick up a bag today? :one: yes, :two: wait till Friday
Claire: :one: please. Also if you buy beans can you get a medium roast? Not everyone likes the dark edge.
Ravi: Cool Theo, if you get beans can you grab oat milk too? We're on our last carton.
Theo: Sure. Options: Oatly or Minor Figures? Which do we prefer? react with :coffee: for Oatly :milk_glass: for Minor Figures
Nina: :milk_glass: Minor Figures pls
Ravi: :coffee: Oatly wins my heart
KitchenBot: Reminder: Community fridge policy -> label items with `Name | Date` or items older than 72 hours may be composted. Next tidy: Friday 9:30am. :robot_face:
Claire: Can someone also check the espresso machine portafilter? It was left with grounds yesterday and it'll clog. Quick 30s rinse after use please.
Theo: I'll clean it now. Also left a sticky note suggestion: `If you make >2 cups, please leave a note on the board for more beans`. Saves mid-afternoon disappointment.
Nina: Love that idea. Maybe we add a tiny 'coffee fund' jar for barista-level beans? voluntary contributions only.
Ravi: Added a small repurposed jar on the counter labeled "Coffee Fund". No pressure.
Claire: Thanks! Back to jar 1: I sealed it and put it on the counter with a note: 'Unknown - do not eat'. If no one claims by Friday it'll go.
Theo: Pickups: grabbing beans & oat milk in ~30m. Anything else? snacks?
Nina: Chips would be awesome. Prefer multigrain or plain?
Theo: Multigrain ok. I'll get one bag.
Ravi: Awesome. Also reminder: microwave rule - cover containers or use the splatter screen. Last week's spaghetti re-entry was dramatic. :face_vomiting:
Claire: Amen. I'll print two small labels: `Name | Date` and `DO NOT LEAVE FOOD UNCOVERED`. Stick them on the fridge and microwave.
KitchenBot: Action logged: Theo will supply coffee + oat milk + chips (ETA 30m). Fridge tidy reminder set for Friday. :white_check_mark:
